name: Lao PDR
headline: Lao PDR: +4.8% growth in 2025, 7.7% inflation, debt 89% of GDP
sections: Lao PDR is a $16.9 billion economy (2025), the world's 143rd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +4.8% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $10K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 9.1% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 7.7% in 2025, above typical targets, down from 23.0% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 1.2% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 2.4% (2025).
Gross government debt is 89% of GDP (2025), a elevated level that has risen from 75% in 2020. The general government balance is +1.9% of GDP (2025), a surplus.
The current account balance is +12.0% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Net FDI inflows were 7.7% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 52% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 69.2 years (2024). Population: 7.8 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
